name: anveshana-central-university-club
description: ANVESHANA Central University Club - Explore • Build • Bring Ideas to Life

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build:client: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.build:server: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.build: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix server run build
